title: 8″ Dopezilla Kraken Dab Rig – Black
description:
Description
Sailors beware, the Kraken has arrived. It’s a clear beaker dab rig with coloured accents on the mouthpiece, base and monster logo. It features a drum percolator to make your hit so smooth, you’ll need to get your tentacles on it before it’s gone.
The 8” Kraken beaker comes delivered with a male 14.5mm quartz banger. A banger is the preferred method for dabbing, making it easier and more efficient to use than typical accessories of the past.
If you’re looking for a solid and horrifying beaker dab rig to add to your glass collection, you have found your ideal piece.
High quality borosilicate glass.
Beaker base.
14.5mm Female Joint.
Male 14.5mm quartz banger.
Drum percolator.
No carb hole.
Colourful accents on the mouthpiece, bowl and monster logo.
